scenario: Two people are in the same room. One has brought some high-quality stationery items they don't want others to use without permission.
learner_goal: Prevent the other person from using your stuff (<extra_info>Extra information: the stationery items are quite expensive and you don't want them to be damaged or lost <strategy_hint>Hint: you can suggest the monetary risk of the other person if they use your stuff</strategy_hint></extra_info>)
partner_goal: Borrow some stationery items for your project (<extra_info>Extra information: you forgot to bring your stationery and need some for the project.</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Micah Stevens
transcript.content: Hey Jaxon — quick heads-up: those stationery items are mine and they're pretty high-end. I don't let others use them because if they get lost or damaged the replacement cost is substantial, and I'd rather avoid that. If you need something to write with I can grab a pen from my bag for you.

transcript.speaker: Jaxon Prentice
transcript.content: Thanks for the heads-up, Micah — I get it. I’m on a tight deadline and completely forgot my kit. Would you be okay if I borrowed a single pen and one sheet of paper just long enough to finish a quick section? I’ll use them carefully and hand them back right away; if anything gets damaged or lost I’ll cover replacement. If you’d rather I take the pen from your bag, that works too. Appreciate it either way.

transcript.speaker: Micah Stevens
transcript.content: I appreciate it, Jaxon, but I’m going to pass — I don’t want my high-end set at risk even if you cover it. I can grab a cheap disposable pen and a sheet of scrap paper for you right now so you can finish; I’ll make sure not to touch the premium stuff. Sound good?

transcript.speaker: Jaxon Prentice
transcript.content: Thanks, Micah — that would be perfect. I really appreciate you grabbing a disposable pen and a sheet of scrap paper. Don’t worry about your high-end set; I won’t touch it. I’ll be quick and I owe you one — coffee or I can cover the cost, whichever you prefer. Thanks again.
